title: Foldable Garden Kneeler & Tool Seat
googleProductCategory: Home & Garden > Lawn & Garden > Gardening > Gardening Tools

images.alt: Thornstead foldable garden kneeler and tool seat, front view
Thornstead garden kneeler and tool seat in use in a garden border
Close-up of the folding hinge and cushion on the Thornstead garden kneeler

shortDescription: A powder-coated steel frame that flips from a kneeling pad to a garden seat, with a thick foam cushion and two side pockets for hand tools.
description: Weeding a border and then needing somewhere to sit are the same job, so the Thornstead kneeler does both. Flip it one way and the padded cushion sits low to the ground with steel handles either side to help you get back up. Flip it over and it becomes a stable seat at a comfortable height for potting, pruning or sowing. The frame folds flat in one movement, so it stores against a shed wall or in the boot of a car without taking a shelf hostage. Two detachable pockets carry secateurs, twine, labels and gloves so you are not walking back to the shed every ten minutes.
features: Reverses between a kneeling pad and a raised garden seat
25mm high-density foam cushion over a powder-coated steel frame
Folds flat in one movement for storage
Two detachable tool pockets included
Supports up to 150kg

title: Galvanised Steel Planters, Set of 3
googleProductCategory: Home & Garden > Lawn & Garden > Gardening > Pots & Planters

images.alt: Set of three Thornstead galvanised steel planters in graduated sizes
Thornstead galvanised steel planters grouped on a patio, planted with herbs
Close view of the rolled rim and drainage holes on a Thornstead planter

shortDescription: Three graduated planters in hot-dip galvanised steel with rolled rims and pre-drilled drainage, for herbs, bulbs and small shrubs.
description: Galvanised steel weathers to a soft grey rather than flaking like painted metal, which is why we use it for this set of three. The planters nest in graduated sizes so you can group them on a patio, line them along a path or split them between rooms and a doorstep. Each has a rolled rim that is comfortable to lift and stiffens the body, plus pre-drilled drainage holes in the base so roots are not sitting in water after a wet week. They suit herbs and salad in the smallest, bulbs and bedding in the middle, and a compact shrub or acer in the largest.
features: Hot-dip galvanised steel that weathers without flaking
Three graduated sizes for grouping or splitting up
Rolled rims for comfortable, rigid handling
Pre-drilled drainage holes in every base
Suitable for indoor and outdoor use

title: Water-Resistant Outdoor Storage Box, 120L
googleProductCategory: Home & Garden > Household Supplies > Storage & Organization > Storage Boxes

images.alt: Thornstead 120 litre water-resistant outdoor storage box with the lid closed
Thornstead storage box on a patio with the lid open showing the internal capacity
Close-up of the gas-strut hinge and lid seam on the Thornstead storage box

shortDescription: A 120 litre resin box with an overlapping lid, gas-strut hinges and a ventilated base, sized to swallow cushions or tools and double as a bench.
description: Garden cushions live indoors far more than they should because there is nowhere dry to put them. This box holds 120 litres, which is a two-seater set of cushions or a full run of hand tools, and the lid overlaps the body so rain runs off the sides rather than into the seam. Gas struts hold the lid open while you load it and lower it slowly instead of dropping on your fingers. The base is ribbed and slightly raised so air moves underneath and damp does not collect on a patio. The lid is rated to sit on, so it works as a bench by a back door.
features: 120 litre capacity with an overlapping, rain-shedding lid
Gas struts hold the lid open and lower it slowly
Ventilated, raised base that resists trapped damp
Lid rated as a seat for up to 120kg
UV-stabilised resin that will not need painting

title: Bamboo Raised Garden Bed
googleProductCategory: Home & Garden > Lawn & Garden > Gardening > Pots & Planters

images.alt: Thornstead bamboo raised garden bed, empty
Thornstead bamboo raised garden bed planted with vegetables
Corner joint detail of the Thornstead bamboo raised bed

shortDescription: A waist-height bed in moso bamboo with a lined growing trough and a lower shelf, deep enough for carrots, salad and dwarf beans.
description: A raised bed at waist height turns growing vegetables into something you do standing up, which matters if kneeling is uncomfortable or the garden is a paved yard. The trough is 30cm deep, enough for carrots and beetroot rather than only shallow salad, and it comes with a removable liner so soil stays in and the bamboo stays dry. Drainage holes run the length of the base. Underneath there is a slatted shelf for watering cans, seed trays and gloves. Moso bamboo is dense, fast-growing and finished here with a plant-safe oil rather than a film that peels.
features: Waist-height growing without kneeling or bending
30cm deep trough, suitable for root vegetables
Removable liner with full-length drainage holes
Slatted lower shelf for cans, trays and tools
Moso bamboo finished with a plant-safe oil

title: Solar-Powered Garden Lights, Pack of 6

images.alt: Six Thornstead solar garden lights arranged in a row
Thornstead solar garden lights glowing along a path at dusk
Detail of a Thornstead solar light head and ground spike

shortDescription: Six stake lights with warm white LEDs, an IP65 housing and a dusk sensor, giving roughly eight hours from a full summer charge.
description: Path lighting should not involve a trench and an electrician. These six stake lights push into a border or lawn, charge through the day and switch themselves on at dusk. The LEDs are warm white rather than the blue-white that makes a garden feel like a car park, and the frosted lens spreads light down onto the path instead of into your neighbour's window. Housings are IP65 rated, so British weather is the expected condition rather than an exception. A full summer charge gives around eight hours; expect less in midwinter, which is normal for every solar light.
features: Six lights per pack with ground spikes included
Warm white LEDs with a frosted, downward-spreading lens
Automatic dusk-to-dawn sensor, no switch to remember
IP65 rated housing for year-round outdoor use
Around 8 hours of light from a full summer charge

title: Heavy-Duty Garden Kneeling Pad

images.alt: Thornstead heavy-duty garden kneeling pad
Thornstead kneeling pad in use beside a flower border
Close-up of the textured surface and carry handle on the Thornstead kneeling pad

shortDescription: A 40mm closed-cell foam pad that stays dry on wet ground, with a moulded grip handle and a wipe-clean surface.
description: Forty millimetres of closed-cell foam is the difference between an hour of planting and five minutes before your knees complain. Closed-cell means the foam does not soak up water, so the pad can sit on wet grass or a rained-on patio and still be dry on top. The surface is textured to grip rather than slide on decking, and it wipes clean with a cloth instead of needing a hose. A moulded handle is cut into one end so it hangs on a shed hook and carries in the same hand as a trowel.
features: 40mm closed-cell foam that does not absorb water
Textured, non-slip surface for decking and patios
Moulded carry handle, hangs on a shed hook
Wipes clean with a damp cloth
Will not crack in frost or perish in sunlight

title: Stainless Steel Watering Can, 5L
googleProductCategory: Home & Garden > Lawn & Garden > Gardening > Watering Equipment > Watering Cans

images.alt: Thornstead 5 litre stainless steel watering can with brass rose
Thornstead watering can being used on potted seedlings
Detachable brass rose from the Thornstead watering can

shortDescription: A 5 litre can in brushed stainless steel with a long balanced spout and a detachable brass rose for seedlings.
description: Plastic cans crack at the handle after two summers in the sun. This one is brushed stainless steel with a rolled rim and welded seams, so it lasts and it looks like something you leave out rather than hide. Five litres is the sensible compromise: enough to water a run of pots without refilling, light enough to carry full in one hand. The spout is long and set low on the body, which keeps the flow steady as the can empties and lets you reach the back of a border. A brass rose twists off for a fine spray over seedlings, or leave it off to water directly at the roots.
features: Brushed 201 stainless steel with welded, leak-free seams
Long low-set spout for a steady flow and extra reach
Detachable brass rose for a fine seedling spray
Balanced handle that stays comfortable when full
Suitable for indoor plants and outdoor borders

title: Compact Kitchen Compost Bin

Thornstead compost bin on a kitchen countertop
Lid of the Thornstead compost bin lifted to show the carbon filter

shortDescription: A 5 litre worktop caddy in powder-coated steel with a replaceable carbon filter in the lid and a removable inner bucket.
description: A food caddy only gets used if it can sit on the worktop without being unpleasant, so this one has a carbon filter set into the lid that takes the edge off between emptyings, and a lid that seals rather than rests. Five litres is roughly two or three days of peelings for a small household. The inner bucket lifts out with a wire handle so you can carry it to the garden bin and rinse it in the sink, leaving the outer shell clean. The shell is powder-coated steel in muted colours rather than white plastic that stains after a month of coffee grounds.
features: Replaceable carbon filter fitted in the lid
Removable inner bucket with a wire carry handle
5 litre capacity, around 2–3 days for a small household
Powder-coated steel shell that wipes clean
Compatible with standard compostable caddy liners

title: Weatherproof Garden Furniture Cover Set
googleProductCategory: Home & Garden > Lawn & Garden > Outdoor Living > Outdoor Furniture Accessories > Outdoor Furniture Covers

images.alt: Thornstead weatherproof garden furniture cover set, folded
Thornstead weatherproof covers fitted over a garden table and chairs
Detail of the taped seam and drawcord hem on a Thornstead furniture cover

shortDescription: A three-piece cover set in 600D coated polyester with taped seams, mesh vents and drawcord hems, for a table and two chair stacks.
description: Furniture covers fail in two ways: they let water through the seams, or they trap it underneath and everything grows mould. This set is made from 600D polyester with a waterproof coating and taped seams for the first problem, and mesh vents in the top panels for the second, so air keeps moving and condensation does not sit on the table. Elasticated, drawcord hems pull tight under the edges so a gust does not turn the cover into a sail across the lawn. The set covers a rectangular table plus two stacks of chairs, and each piece packs into its own storage bag over winter.
features: 600D polyester with a waterproof coating and taped seams
Mesh air vents that reduce condensation and mould
Elasticated drawcord hems that hold in wind
Three pieces: one table cover, two chair-stack covers
Storage bags included for each piece

title: Wooden Bird Feeding Station
googleProductCategory: Home & Garden > Decor > Bird & Wildlife Feeders

images.alt: Thornstead wooden bird feeding station
Thornstead bird feeding station with birds perched on the arms
Mesh seed tray and hanging arm detail of the Thornstead bird feeding station

shortDescription: A 1.9m FSC-certified pine station with four hanging arms, a seed tray, a water dish and a ground spike for lawns or borders.
description: One post, four hanging points, and suddenly a garden has proper bird traffic. This station is FSC-certified pine, pressure treated so it stays in the ground year-round rather than rotting through its first wet winter. Four arms take seed feeders, fat balls, peanuts and a nyjer feeder at once, which is what actually brings in a range of species rather than only pigeons. A mesh seed tray sits mid-post to catch spill, and a shallow water dish clips on lower down for drinking and bathing. The spike drives into a lawn or border, and the post unscrews into three sections for storage.
features: FSC-certified pine, pressure treated for year-round use
Four hanging arms for seed, fat balls, peanuts and nyjer
Mesh seed tray that catches spill under the feeders
Clip-on water dish for drinking and bathing
Three-section post with a ground spike, no digging needed
